test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

I asked my friend how one could be merry when everything was so messed up.

options.text: I said to my friend, “ How can one be merry when everything is so messed up?”
I asked to my friend, “ How can one be merry when everything was so messed up?”
I said to my friend, “ How one could be merry when everything was so messed up?”
I said to my friend, “ Could one be merry when everything is so messed up?”

solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When converting indirect speech to direct speech, ensure the tense and punctuation are correct.
 
• Option 1 maintains the original question's structure and tense accurately, making it the most suitable choice.

Hence, the correct statement is ***I said to my friend,** **"How can one be merry when everything is so messed up?"***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 is incorrect due to the **incorrect use of "asked to"**.
 
• Option 3 is incorrect due to** mismatch in verb tense**.
 
• Option 4 is incorrect as it **changes the meaning of the original question.**
